title: Pierre Deligne Papers: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Drafts
version: 2026-06-04 Deligne working record: diagram-audited D015, forward papers 001-015, reverse papers 080-090, and complete correspondence reader lane
description:
Dedicated Deligne record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This page is separate from the main corpus so Deligne material can be cited, revised, or reorganized independently.

The top-level files are reader-facing and are intentionally English-first where an English translation is present. Individual English paper PDFs, selected French source/working PDFs, and separate correspondence items are exposed for direct download. Broader reference PDFs and TeX/source artifacts are kept in ZIP files rather than cluttering the front-facing reader list.

Status at a glance. The record now has three visible lanes. [#######---] forward paper stream: source-checked working readers cover papers 001-013 complete, paper 014 through page 30, and paper 015; this is not yet a finished 001-015 critical run. [##########] reverse paper stream: source-checked working readers cover papers 090 down through 080, with paper 079 pages 1-10 held locally as a partial packet and not promoted as complete. [##########] correspondence lane: twelve Deligne letter/correspondence readers are present in English, each paired with a French working/source PDF. Original/reference and provenance material is preserved in ZIP artifacts. These are working scholarly transcriptions and translation drafts, not proofed critical editions.

Latest update. Refreshed the forward 001-015 cumulative and paper 015 readers with the diagram-audited Artin-Mumford/D015 packet. The packet specifically rechecks papers 006-015 and rebuilds the Artin-Mumford diagram layer while preserving the reverse 090-down-through-080 stream and the twelve-item correspondence lane as first-class public material. Paper 079 pages 1-10 exist locally as a partial working packet and are not promoted as a complete reader yet.
notes: Latest metadata update promotes the diagram-audited Artin-Mumford/D015 refresh for the forward 001-015 stream while keeping the reverse 080-090 paper stream and the twelve-item Deligne correspondence reader lane prominent.
